title: 7 Foods So Weird They Should NOT Exist!
description:
There's a cheese in Italy that is still ALIVE when you eat it - and it's only number 7 on this list. From $600 poop coffee to fish that's BANNED on airplanes, these are the 7 weirdest real foods on Earth, ranked!

I'm scoring every dish on the Weirdness Scale from 1 to 10. Number one got a perfect TEN - it made me question humanity itself. Which one would YOU actually try? Tell me in the comments!

CHAPTERS:

08:14 No.1 Casu Marzu - The Live Maggot Cheese (Italy)
09:48 Final Ranking Recap
10:08 Which One Would YOU Try?
